description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain period of time after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Stage 4.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack.
Moments after a Basic Attack or Heavy Attack, Qiuyuan becomes immune to the next instance of DMG he takes and casts Dodge Counter upon being attacked, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG. Tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Tahap 4.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack.
Sesaat setelah Basic Attack atau Heavy Attack, Qiuyuan kebal terhadap DMG berikutnya yang diterimanya dan melancarkan Dodge Counter saat diserang, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Press Resonance Skill to dash forward for a distance, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Echo Skill DMG. If Resonance Skill is cast upon being attacked by an enemy target, Qiuyuan becomes immune to this instance of DMG and stagnates nearby enemies, while gaining immunity to interruption during this Resonance Skill.
Switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect from enemies.

Undaunted Wayfarer

Hold Resonance Skill to dash forward for a distance at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG to the target, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
If there are no targets nearby, Qiuyuan will leap up and dash through the air by continuously consuming STA until it runs out. Release Resonance Skill to immediately end the dash and land. If there are targets nearby when Qiuyuan lands, deal Aero DMG to nearby targets, considered as Echo Skill DMG. This skill can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Tekan Resonance Skill untuk melesat ke depan sejauh jarak tertentu, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG. Jika Resonance Skill dilancarkan saat diserang target musuh, Qiuyuan kebal terhadap DMG tersebut dan menahan musuh di sekitar (Stagnation), sekaligus kebal terhadap interupsi selama Resonance Skill ini.
Berganti ke Resonator lain menghapus efek Stagnation dari musuh.

Undaunted Wayfarer

Tahan Resonance Skill untuk melesat ke depan sejauh jarak tertentu dengan mengorbankan STA, memberikan Aero DMG ke target, dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG.
Jika tidak ada target di sekitar, Qiuyuan akan melompat dan melesat di udara dengan terus-menerus mengonsumsi STA hingga habis. Lepas Resonance Skill untuk langsung mengakhiri lesatan dan mendarat. Jika ada target di sekitar saat Qiuyuan mendarat, berikan Aero DMG ke target di sekitar, dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG. Skill ini dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en:
Deal Aero DMG to targets within range, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
For every 1% of Qiuyuan's Crit. Rate over 50%, this skill increases the Crit. DMG of all nearby active Resonators in the team by 2% for 30s, up to 30%.
description.id:
Memberikan Aero DMG ke target dalam jangkauan, dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG.
Untuk setiap 1% Crit. Rate Qiuyuan di atas 50%, skill ini meningkatkan Crit. DMG seluruh Resonator aktif di sekitar dalam tim sebesar 2% selama 30 dtk, hingga maksimal 30%.

description.en:
Qiuyuan obtains Quietude Within for 10s upon entering the Inksplash of Mind state. This effect can be triggered once every 22s.
Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, and Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice deal 50% more DMG. Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy on hit.
- This effect ends early when Qiuyuan is switched off the field.
description.id:
Qiuyuan memperoleh Quietude Within selama 10 dtk saat memasuki kondisi Inksplash of Mind. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 22 dtk.
Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, dan Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice memberikan 50% lebih banyak DMG. Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice juga memulihkan 30 poin Concerto Energy saat mengenai target.
- Efek ini berakhir lebih awal saat Qiuyuan diganti keluar lapangan.

description.en:
When casting Echo Skill, Qiuyuan's bamboo flask absorbs the overflowing energy and brews it into Flowing Panacea.
The next time Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained, the Flowing Panacea is consumed to gain 10% ATK increase for 20s.
description.id:
Saat melancarkan Echo Skill, labu bambu Qiuyuan menyerap energi yang meluap dan meraciknya menjadi Flowing Panacea.
Saat Swordster's Soliloquy diperoleh berikutnya, Flowing Panacea dikonsumsi untuk mendapat peningkatan ATK sebesar 10% selama 20 dtk.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Within a certain period of time after casting this skill, press Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Stage 3.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Tahap 3.

description.en:
Basic Attack - Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash

When Qiuyuan reaches 200 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, his Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash, which chains together up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Bamboo's Shade

When Qiuyuan reaches 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, he gains the Bamboo's Shade effect, granting all nearby active Resonators in the team 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.

Inksplash of Mind

When Swordster's Soliloquy is full, Qiuyuan enters the Inksplash of Mind state for 8s, during which Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save.
In this state, hold Normal Attack to consume Swordster's Soliloquy to perform Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, and Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice in order, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Performing Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, or Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice is considered as performing Echo Skill.
- Inksplash of Mind ends when Swordster's Soliloquy is used up.

Swordster's Soliloquy

Qiuyuan can hold up to 600 points of Swordster's Soliloquy.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Basic Attack Stage 3.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing each stage of Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Dodge Counter.
- 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Intro Skill.
- Swordster's Soliloquy cannot be obtained in the Inksplash of Mind state.
- Swordster's Soliloquy is cleared when the Inksplash of Mind state ends.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash

Saat Qiuyuan mencapai 200 poin Swordster's Soliloquy, Basic Attack miliknya diganti dengan Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash, yang merangkai hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Bamboo's Shade

Saat Qiuyuan mencapai 400 poin Swordster's Soliloquy, ia mendapat efek Bamboo's Shade, memberikan 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus kepada seluruh Resonator aktif di sekitar dalam tim selama 30 dtk.

Inksplash of Mind

Saat Swordster's Soliloquy penuh, Qiuyuan memasuki kondisi Inksplash of Mind selama 8 dtk, dan selama itu Heavy Attack diganti dengan Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save.
Dalam kondisi ini, tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi Swordster's Soliloquy dan melakukan Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, dan Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice secara berurutan, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
- Melakukan Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, atau Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice dianggap sebagai melakukan Echo Skill.
- Inksplash of Mind berakhir saat Swordster's Soliloquy habis terpakai.

Swordster's Soliloquy

Qiuyuan dapat menyimpan hingga 600 poin Swordster's Soliloquy.
- 100 poin Swordster's Soliloquy diperoleh saat melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3.
- 100 poin Swordster's Soliloquy diperoleh saat melakukan setiap tahap Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash.
- 100 poin Swordster's Soliloquy diperoleh saat melakukan Dodge Counter.
- 400 poin Swordster's Soliloquy diperoleh saat melakukan Intro Skill.
- Swordster's Soliloquy tidak dapat diperoleh dalam kondisi Inksplash of Mind.
- Swordster's Soliloquy dihapus saat kondisi Inksplash of Mind berakhir.

Memberikan Amplify Echo Skill DMG sebesar 50% kepada Resonator yang masuk, selama 14 dtk atau hingga Resonator tersebut diganti keluar.

sequences.name: O Blade, I, Who Save No More

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Sundering Strike is increased by 500%.
If Concerto Energy is full when not in the Inksplash of Mind state, Qiuyuan's Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, available once every 20s.
Upon casting Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, the Quietude Within effect immediately ends and 60 Concerto Energy is consumed to deal Aero DMG equal to 500% of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered Echo Skill DMG, and restore 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy. The next Basic Attack is replaced with Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Stage 3.
Upon casting Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, Qiuyuan cannot gain the Quietude Within effect the next time he enters Inksplash of Mind. Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, and Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice gain 600% DMG Multiplier increase and additionally restore 30 point of Concerto Energy on hit.
When not in Co-op mode, upon casting Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, the next Outro Skill is replaced with Outro Skill Sheath Fallen, New Shoots Revealed, which deals Aero DMG equal to 500% of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered Echo Skill DMG.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Sundering Strike meningkat sebesar 500%.
Jika Concerto Energy penuh saat tidak dalam kondisi Inksplash of Mind, Resonance Skill Qiuyuan diganti dengan Resonance Skill Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, yang tersedia sekali setiap 20 dtk.
Saat melancarkan Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, efek Quietude Within langsung berakhir dan 60 Concerto Energy dikonsumsi untuk memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 500% ATK Qiuyuan, dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG, dan memulihkan 400 poin Swordster's Soliloquy. Basic Attack berikutnya diganti dengan Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Tahap 3.
Saat melancarkan Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, Qiuyuan tidak dapat memperoleh efek Quietude Within pada saat berikutnya ia memasuki Inksplash of Mind. Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, dan Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice mendapat peningkatan Pengali DMG sebesar 600% dan juga memulihkan 30 poin Concerto Energy saat mengenai target.
Saat tidak dalam mode Co-op, saat melancarkan Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, Outro Skill berikutnya diganti dengan Outro Skill Sheath Fallen, New Shoots Revealed, yang memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 500% ATK Qiuyuan, dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG.

sequences.name: Thus I Heard, Thus I Saw, Thus I Spoke

description.en:
Casting Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice stagnates nearby targets for 5s or until the targets are damaged or until Qiuyuan is switched off the field. This effect is not available in the Co-op Mode.
When Qiuyuan is the active Resonator in the team, upon exiting Inksplash of Mind, he deals Aero DMG equal to 600% of his ATK to all targets within range, considered Echo Skill DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain increases Qiuyuan's Crit. DMG by 100% for 6s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.
description.id:
Melancarkan Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice menahan target di sekitar (Stagnation) selama 5 dtk atau hingga target menerima damage atau hingga Qiuyuan diganti keluar lapangan. Efek ini tidak tersedia dalam Co-op Mode.
Saat Qiuyuan adalah Resonator aktif dalam tim, saat keluar dari Inksplash of Mind, ia memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 600% ATK-nya ke seluruh target dalam jangkauan, dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG.
Melancarkan Resonance Skill Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain meningkatkan Crit. DMG Qiuyuan sebesar 100% selama 6 dtk. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek ini lebih awal.
